content.title: NCAA Championships: Finals Live Stream: How to Watch College Wrestling
content.text: Penn State looks to complete its dominating weekend for the NCAA Championships: Finals on Saturday. The NCAA College Wrestling Championships conclude on Saturday in the tournament finals. Session V, which includes the Medal Matches, will air at 11:00 a.m. ET on ESPNU. There will be wall-to-wall coverage of these Finals, so make sure to stick around throughout the day, as the Finals matches start at 6:30 p.m. ET on ESPN. Penn State is primed to win another National Championship once again under head coach Cael Sanderson, which would be his 13th national title at the helm. This would be the Nittany Lions’ fifth straight title win if they are able to hold onto their lead on the final day. Penn State leads the field by a wide margin with 153 points. Oklahoma State made up some ground in the semifinals, sitting in second with 111.5 points. The Cowboys entered the semis sitting behind Nebraska, which is now in third with 90.5. Iowa (81.0) and Ohio State (77.5) round out the top five teams. Can anyone catch up with Penn State to end its run of absolute dominance? How to Watch NCAA Championships: Finals today: Game Date: Saturday, Mar. 21, 2026 Game Time: 11:00 a.m. & 6:30 p.m. ET TV: ESPN, ESPNU Location: Rocket Arena – Cleveland, OH Live stream NCAA Championships: Finals on Fubo: Start watching now! Maybe the biggest David vs Goliath underdog story has been Marc-Anthony McGowan of Princeton, who made the finals today as the No. 10 seed at 125 lbs. McGowan will have his biggest challenge yet, facing off against the No. 1 seed in the weight class, Luke Lilledahl. Of the 10 finals matchups, a Penn State player is represented in six of them. Oklahoma State has four competing finalists, while Ohio State and Nebraska have two. Iowa, Minnesota, Iowa State, and NC State all have one representative in the final rounds today. These matchups range from 125 to 285 lbs. There is every type of style of wrestling represented today, so there is a matchup for everyone.
